description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to land parcel in Galigamuwa D/S Division - Cad. Map No. 610022 and other land parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It deals specifically with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land title determinations, and property registration matters across multiple districts. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures, making it a clear fit for the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) rather than government personnel/structure categories or other specialized types.
